items.title: Arrive at JFK Terminal 8 (Cathay Pacific Desk)
highlights: Walk times from T8 security to gates: 1–10 about 2–5 min, 12–20 about 2–4 min, 31–41 about 6–12 min, 42–47 about 6–8 min.
T8 lounges: Chelsea, Greenwich and Soho (premium), American Admirals Club; Minute Suites private nap/work suites near Gate 37; Jabbrrbox pods at check-in.
60+ shops and restaurants in T8, many with order-ahead mobile pickup.
tips: Cathay online check-in lets you pick seats, store a mobile boarding pass and use self-service bag drop instead of the counter queue.
TWAC (Taiwan arrival card) is free and accepted only within 7 days before arrival; for a Nov 29 landing, file it from about Nov 23 so it is done before you leave home.
Check the live TSA wait shown on the JFK T8 page before leaving home (sampled at 23 min general / 7 min PreCheck on Nov 11).
items.watch: Cathay did not publish a T8 counter-closing time on a page that could be read; treat the boarding pass and airport screens as final.

items.title: Board Flight CX841 to Hong Kong
items.hours: Scheduled 09:00 EST from JFK → 14:05 HKT next day at HKG; 16h05 block.
highlights: Usual equipment recently: Airbus A350-900 (e.g., B-LRD, B-LRK, B-LRI).
In early Nov 2026 most CX841 flights pushed back 09:05–09:30 and several landed at HKG well before 14:05 (12:48–13:59).
tips: An early landing adds slack to the HKG connection; a late one eats into it — check the CX472 gate as soon as you are on the ground.
Note the 09:00 departure applies after the US switch to standard time; October flights left at 10:00 EDT.
Cathay's flight-status tool only covers departures up to 6 days ahead, so live status for Nov 28 appears from about Nov 22.
items.watch: PlaneMapper logged 3 delays on CX841 in the prior month (average 154 min). Third-party schedule data — Cathay app/boarding pass is final.
